name: Moebius Omnibus
description: An 8' round omnidirectional "flying saucer" morphed into a comfy couch with umbrella for about 12 participants to interact on.

name: Humblebee
description: Humblebee is a polygonal adaptation of Bumblebee.  The wings will unfold on deep playa and the legs will move while driving.

name: the Mushroom Patch
description: The Mushroom Patch is a fanciful transport for the citizens of BRC. Five giant mushrooms sprout out of a colorful plush platform which is accessible from all directions. The mushrooms provide shade during the day and glow with brilliantly changing lights at night.

name: LilyPod
description: Lilypad - most comfortable way to float upon the playa
artist: LilyPad Car by Lilypad Lounge crew

name: The Boob Tube
description: What does every burner in the history of all burners miss the most while on the playa? Television, of course! So... Ladies and germs, freaks, hippies, yuppies, ravers, tech-bros, evil billionaires and everything in-between, the whole spectrum of burnery burnerness -- may we present to you The Boob Tube, Black Rock City's custom-built drivable TV -- bringing joy, merriment, and quality fun-casting to the playa since 2013!
artist: The Boob Tube by Patrick & Evelyn Gleason

name: Lucky Fucky Ducky
description:
Once upon a splash, there lived a duck who was too big for the bathtub.
He was a trickster at heart, always stirring up
mischief, charming the flock, and dreaming of
golden horizons. Some say he's looking for trouble.
Others say he's running from bubbles.
Either way, if you see him driving by,
feathers gleaming gold, his
daring soul shining through
the stripper pole, jump on
and take a spin.

name: Pumablanco
description: Pumablanco is an all white, furry, rolling mattress during the day...transforming to a psychedelic light show at night.
artist: Pumablanco by Damien Otis, Ulli Bu & Puma

name: Fluffy
description:
Fluffy is accessible public transit masquerading as a wafting cloud to elicit and excite your dreams. A wheelchair lift and Braille rails make a mutant vehicle experience
accessible to that many more Burners. Gifting forays provide iced liquid refreshment in
the heat of the day (Deep Playa Beer Delivery) and warm gooey treats in the chill of the
night (Smores). Come Fluffy with us.

name: Eye Of Providence
description: The all-seeing eye symbolizes the eye of God always watching. Giving it a meta representation of week that goes on during Burning Man. Deep in the lore of the all-seeing eye is the connection to the Freemasons, giving the Eye of Providence a connection to the counterculture of society.
artist: Eye of Providence By Trent Thomas

name: HEPA Filter
description: The Hardly Effective Playa Anti-dust aka HEPA Filter is a whimsically ineffective device for keeping Black Rock City free of dust while providing rides for lots of burners

name: Little Red Rocket
description:
There's something about changing an objects history or its inherent value that I find interesting. I like to invite viewers to re think the way an object is used by giving new life to the discarded, but also who I am as a person who always trys to do more with less.
The Little Red Rocket carries the same idea. Besides some of the lighting no new materials were purchased for the direct build of this MV. Everything was resourced from reclaimed wood, personal items I wasn't using all that much, and left over art supplies. I collect a lot of things so when I go to create I have something to start with. Everything I had happen to be red and then..it just built itself.

name: Uuna Ahi
description: A giant metal fire shooting Moai
artist: Uuna Ahi mutant vehicle by camp WrongoWrongo

name: Chester
description: A more apropriate name would be, DARK HORSE OF THE APOCALYPSE!" It's a long story.

name: USS Nevada
description: USS Nevada is the oldest pirate ship on the Playa, bringing pirate joy and mischief all over the Playa!

name: Bulgarian Kuker
description: Bulgarian KUKER, produced by HitterPetter Production House L.A., represents the 5000 year old Bulgarian tradition of KUKERI RITUAL DANCERS - masked people dressed up in animalistic outfits to scare away evil spirits and bring prosperity and happiness to the village.

name: Barbie Whorehouse
description: It is a spicy version of the well known Barbie Play House with hot pink exterior and purple accents. Riders enjoy the comfort of the first level or the second level balcony.
artist: Barbie Whorehouse by Barbie Death Village

name: Snuggle Shuttle
description: Snuggle Shuttle is a cozy rolling lounge designed to bring comfort and connection to the open playa. With soft seating, warm lighting, and an inviting atmosphere, it offers participants a place to slow down, share stories, and meet new friends while traveling through Black Rock City. More than transportation, Snuggle Shuttle is a mobile gathering space that encourages meaningful conversation, laughter, and presence. Hop aboard, settle in, and enjoy a gentle ride through the dust with good company.
artist: Snuggle Shuttle by The Schwartz brothers

name: FL Man Fanboat
description: The Florida Man Fanboat proudly glides across the playa rocking live music and sultry cuddle puddles to sunrise sets at the trash fence every night. A voyage supine, we bump funky beats and furry threads, ferrying you everywhere except Robot Heart.

name: Re-In-Karma
description:
Re-in-Karma is the stunning, double-decker beauty — now very familiar to long-time Burners. She is immediately recognizable when you see the shimmering pink wonder cruising by with a warm lie-down lower lounge and a high upper level viewing platform.
Re-in-Karma has an especially wide-open design that offers a wonderful invitation to passing pedestrian Burners. She is often seen carrying the marvelous band from Playa Jazz Cafe to entertain at special events on the playa.
artist: Re-In-Karma by artist Sarah Plaia Davidson

name: Willie the Killer Whale
description: Willie is an illuminated, rideable, mobile sculpture with touch sensitive panels and sound.

name: Pillow Talk
description: A rolling gold and red ornate bed experience connecting burners.

name: ZZYZXT
description: Steam punk Inspired/Great Dane Inspired unique one of a kind vehicle.

name: Abu the Horsefly
description: Abu is inspired by the 1986 animated movie by Studio Miyazaki "Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind." This is the first insect that Princess Nausicaa defends from the angry mob. She helps Abu to find its way home. Abu teaches us that fear and mistrust are the real evils in this world, and only together we can make a difference.
artist: Abu the Horsefly and Abu Crew

name: Sphere Car
description: This rolling dance floor is a party on 3 wheels! Lights, music and multiple observations decks. We will be rolling across the play at an unhurried pace gathering up participants as we go. Not to brag but there's even a sink with soap and running water to wash your filthy putrid hands at.

name: The Magic Flying Carpet
description: The O.G. flying carpet
artist: The Magic Flying Carpet by Soren Curry and friends

name: F-15 Interceptor - Black Rock Air Force
description:
The Black Rock Air Force's F-15 Interceptor is a 40% scale model of the McDonnell-Douglas F-15D Eagle. On the playa since 2007, it has seen service as an Airport Follow-Me vehicle, Ranger transport, and on reconnaissance missions throughout inner and outer playa. 


It is built on an electric golf cart base and was created using fiberglass, steel, wood, foam, and high-intensity LEDs.
artist: F-15 - Black Rock Air Force by Bryan Lang

name: Yaba Daba Do Me
description: A bitchin' two story Flintstone mobile
artist: Yaba daba do me by Scooby/Chris Mcclintock

name: Butterfly love aura
description: From a cocoon of love comes this butterfly to warm the hearts of everyone around. Lighting the way for all of our burner friends. We invite you to take a smaller more detailed ride on something slightly more delicate! Built by a crew from Sacramento, this piece is one of a kind!

name: The Jolly Trolley
description: We're a happy little trolley wanting to meet new friends and offer rides! We may be small out on the playa but don't let that fool you - we have BIG hearts !
artist: The Jolly Trolley by Steve & Shelly Lange

name: Joyism
description: Experience Joyism in all its forms as the yellow canopied Joyism artcar glides by.

name: Lady Whiskey (aka "Chooch")
description: The Lady Whiskey aka "the Chooch" is a 30-foot rusty faux steam locomotive designed and built by Paul Haugland, Molly Murphy, Philip Beber, and a team of dedicated Chooch elves.
artist: Paul Haugland, Molly Murphy, and the Chooch Crew

name: Daddy Long Wheels
description:
This mutant vehicle was built from the ground up specifically for BM.
It looks like a horseless carriage with custom 6 ft. diameter
"old wagon style" wheels. The driver and passengers ride on a big
flat comfortable piece of foam (like a queen size mattress), with a
big foam back support. The vehicle utilizes air-suspension, which can
raise and lower the vehicle like a low rider. When the suspension
is in the full "up" position, the top of the vehicle including the
driver and passengers heads (while seated) are about 10 ft. off the
ground, which makes the vehicle very unique and exciting to look at
and to ride on.
artist: Daddy Long Wheeels by Artist Spencer Buzza

name: Large Marge The Great Pumpkin
description: Large Marge is a spooky carved pumpkin thats comfortable, with lots of lights Halloween decor and candy, trick or treat
artist: Large Marge the Great Pumpkin by Sean Melendrez Sr

name: Shutterbuggy
description: The Shutterbuggy is a mobile photo booth modeled after a 1940s camera. You and your friends can get souvenir photos to commemorate your Burning Man experience.

name: Sweet Ride (was Candy Cart)
description: The Candy Cart brings much needed calories to burners on the playa and beyond. Look for the gummy bears and stop by for some candy!

name: Passion Flower
description: The Passion Flower marries kinetic, visual, and auditory elements in a multi-sensory experience of music. It is equipped with visceral and visionary artificial intelligence, 360-degree sound, and interactive lighting wrapped in blooming layers of dichroic film, Passion Flower reflects the beauty of its surroundings during the day and emits no exhaust or pollution. At night, its colorful LEDs take over, using lidar technology to automatically match the motion of the crowd and the energy of the music.

name: Disco Snail
description: Micro disco snail built on an electric wheelchair base

name: Pingüina
description: Pingüina is a mutant vehicle designed for style, comfort, and utility, shaped like an emperor penguin created in the Playatech construction style of The Man. She glides across the Playa gracefully, rescuing lost burners, providing comfort, and just being...cool.
artist: Pingüina by RADAR, Artcarium, & Pingüina Crew

name: baby buggy
description: 50s style baby buggy

name: Fokaround
description: A roaming illuminated lounge built on a transformed Truck Chassis, this Mutant Vehicle is designed as a mobile sanctuary on the playa. By day it offers an open air platform for rest and connection. By night it becomes a fully animated geometric light sculpture glowing in all directions. Guests are invited to cruise, pause, and share meaningful conversations in a welcoming space that blends art, movement, and community.

name: Cuddle Couch
description: Built for comfort and cruising in style the Cuddle Couch is your safe space to relax with your Burner Amigos and take in all the magic the playa provides.

name: Alladin's Lamp: Making Playa Dreams Come True
description: Alladin's Lamp is a work of mobile art recreating the "bottom of the genie bottle" experience for those in need of comfort in the midst of the desert. Riders are surrounded by colorful cushions and blankets, excellently curated music, and an opportunity to ride the Playa with their fellow burners.
artist: Kristi Anderson Wells and the Alladin's Lamp Team

name: The Wandering Playhouse
description: A moving playground that encourages interactivity and playful nature by allowing users to enjoy dancing, swinging, riding, sliding, and relaxing on The Wandering Playhouse!

name: Glorious Wet Spot
description: The lighted oasis and fun spot for cruising the playa. Dance with us on the upper deck or chill out on the couches down below.

name: Axolitl
description: Axolotl's Little Buddy -- Axolitl

name: Eagle 5
description: It's a well represented copy of the iconic Spaceballs rv .

name: BigKrabCar
description: For the 4nd year on Playa we present BigKrabCar, a Krusty and Dusty Krab for your sideways riding adventures, in, around and all the way to the trash fence of Black Rock City 2026!
artist: Big Krab Car by Rowdy Ali

name: SS TaTa
description: Pink boob submarine built for breast cancer awareness and support
artist: SS TaTa by Melissa Christensen and Teddi Baer

name: Thor-Viking Ship
description: Thor-Viking Ship created by Dennis Alumbaugh.  Lighting by Randy Frasier, both of Reno NV.  The car is maintained by members of camp Brand-Ur-Ass n more.
artist: Thor-Viking Ship by Dennis Alumbaugh & Thor Crew

name: Emergence
description: Lounge, canopy, wings, lights, hearts. We recreate Emergence every year for the love and Community it brings to the Playa. we bring a fun loving experience Through music dance and art we love to serve the community by transporting people to their favorite destinations of art music parties and when necessary to services such as Medical Center Camp Etc our goal is to give community members the best Burning Man experience possible and to promote the vibration of love throughout. welcoming all with open arms
artist: Emergence. Robert Herring.The Ring Leaders of Love

name: The Hush Hush Pony Barn
description: Hush Hush
artist: The Hush Hush Pony Barn Arts Team

name: The Gayatri Shanti
description: The Gayatri Shanti - a manifestation portal vehicle that will help to facilitate the transmutation of one's intentions , manifestations, and desire to release
artist: The Gayatri Shanti by Rootist Lounge

name: The Big Cheese
description: Bringing nostalgia, warmth and cheesy puns to the playa, The Big Cheese is a unique ride.
artist: The Big Cheese by The Big Cheese Art Car Crew

name: El Mango
description: El Mango, a floating mango riding in the middle of the desert.

name: WarPony
description:
An open air 1974 Chevy Blazer with a wooden roof is EXACTLY what we need for our Thunderdome fleet. She's got ridiculous light bars up, down, and sideways. Maybe we'll add some whimsy... like a tire swing - we
haven't had one of those in ... quite some time. WarPony has ample seating for all the folks we can cram on her, and a
little bit more seating on top of that. Please. Please don't sit on the hood. Otherwise, you can scramble all around her
and. Well. Tetanus is at your own risk. She's tall and fun!

name: the vrill society flying saucer
description: our vehicle is a whimsical , stunning , and magical piece of art that stirs the imagination and provokes thought and fun wherever  she goes
artist: the vrill society flying saucer, artist kimo sabe

name: Big Bunny
description: The Big Bunny is pink, furry, welcoming, loving…good vibes only! Dj driven playing funky dirty house music we have a great sound system to get down to. GET ON THE BUNNY ❤️

name: Astral Plain
description: Astral Plain is a warmly lit mutant vehicle designed as a mobile conversation lounge, offering a peaceful and inviting space for introspection, connection, and meaningful dialogue through esoteric experiences.
artist: Astral Plain by Prairie Arts Crew

name: Animal car
description: Animal Car.

name: Storytime
description: Storytime is a larger-than-life Tiffany's banker's lamp and library, building community through the magic of storytelling and reading aloud across the playa. Pick up a book, sit in a circle, and read to friends new and old. Lie back, listen, and watch the stained-glass lampshade slowly change overhead. Share your own stories, or create a new one together. Storytime is a stage for telling, sharing and connection, and a comfortable retreat from the noise, throughout the city and in deep playa

name: Zulai Art Car
description: Zulai (Tathāgata) is a hand-woven bamboo art car shaped like a giant open palm, carrying a serene Buddha figure at one end. Designed to evoke calmness and security, it glides across the playa as a moving sanctuary. At night, Zulai glows from within, transforming into a luminous beacon of peace.

name: The Wonder Wagon
description: Electric vehicle stagecoach propelled by 10 wonder ponies.

name: El Pulpo Magnifico
description: A popular and friendly flaming scrap metal octopus.
artist: El Pulpo Magnifico by Duane Flatmo

name: Bone Voyage
description: Extinction couldn't stop us! Prehistoric oasis roaming the dust. Part mammoth, part tropical sanctuary, we invite you to step inside our lounge or ascend to the belly of the beast for chilled drinks and desert views. A nomadic relic connecting the ancient past to the spirit of the playa.
artist: Bone Voyage car by Art Kevorkov & Bone Voyage Crew

name: The Cuttlefish
description: The Cuttlefish ( formerly known as Sepia Lux) is the only known animatronic, inflatable cuttlefish. Lit with thousands of LED's and equipped with big sound.

name: Flash
description: Flash the tortoise is A radically modified gem car utilizing custom aluminum shell structure and backlit LED panels.

name: Queen of the Galaxy
description: The Queen of the Galaxy is a mobile light show (tunnel of lights) with a Barbarella theme (think mirrored tiles with pink and white fur).
artist: The Queen of the Galaxy by Van Der Keuken

name: XS Baggage
description: An exploration of baggage, both physical and emotional, and their place in each individual's personal journey. With a blend of whimsey and nostalgia, XS Baggage invites inspection and introspection. A visual representation of the C.S. Lewis quote,"It's not he load that breaks you down, it's how you carry it."
artist: XS Baggage by Paul Lucas and team

name: Brass
description: A common porch swing made uncommonly mobile.
artist: Brass Swing brought by Ranger Gatsby & Tiddy Bear

name: Scrubby
description: Black Rock City's Cleanest Art Car.

name: The Struggle Bus
description: A fusion of train, submarine, and bus, The Struggle Bus is a steampunk spectacle on wheels, rolling through Black Rock City with a mission to help, transport, and entertain. Clad in decorative metal, porthole windows, and a fire-shooting smokestack, it's equal parts mutant vehicle and mobile adventure. By day, it hosts playful art tours with witty banter, and by night, it transforms into a Cyberpunk light show, streaking across the playa with flowing LED trails, and bursts of flame.  Whether offering a ride, a laugh, or a much-needed assist, The Struggle Bus ensures that no burner struggles alone!
artist: The Struggle Bus by Jen and Joel Roberts

name: Infini-Tea Spot
description:
As the Infini-Tea Spot drifts through the night, her shimmering skin is awash in a delicious rainbow glow and pulsing with the life of the Playa. Through loving intent, she becomes a living sculpture, caressing the playa and beckoning. Welcoming you inside the velvety jewel box you'll find an invitation to ceremony, offering warmth, sweetness, and nourishment in the form of late-night tea and cookies. No, expectations here, only the sweet joy of sharing and the magic of the moment.   
 This Infini-Tea Spot pours the spirit of connection, the nourishment of creation, and the warmth of community in motion. Here, we offer a space where the magic of stories unfold, and every sweet soul is welcome, just as they are.

name: Light Party'cle
description: What happens if you caught up with particle of light? This question, posed by a 16-year-old Einstein, is the inspiration behind our mutant vehicle, "Party'cle of Light." Hop in Einstein!
artist: Light Party'cle by Gian Paolo Altomari

name: Shenanigan Wagon
description:
"A quaint covered wagon on the outside, and always a party on the inside, the Shenanigan Wagon is where your
shenanigans begin!
artist: Shenanigan Wagon by the Rabble Rousers

name: The Dusty Fantasy
description: Introducing the Dusty Fantasia Artcar - a captivating fusion of retro nostalgia and innovative design, crafted to immerse you in a 70's summer beach club experience like never before. Picture yourself cruising the playa, surrounded by the sounds of funky beats, tantalizing refreshments, and cool treats, all aboard a unique vessel that promises an unforgettable journey. As you follow the boat on its drives, you'll find yourself drawn into a world of good music, engaging conversation, and water, providing the perfect respite from the desert heat.  venture out into the deep playa and join us for dance parties under the stars.

name: Golden Gate Dream
description: GOLDEN GATE BRIDGE Inspired by the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, this mutant vehicle transforms a 2004 Blue Bird school bus into a rolling suspension bridge of light, sound, and community. By day, bold ship rope defines the bridge's unmistakable silhouette while providing shade and a gathering space for rest and connection. By night, red, white, and blue LED lighting and moving beams bring the structure to life across the playa. Traveling through the city and open desert, the bridge offers rides, music, and cold beverages to dusty travelers, welcoming all citizens of Black Rock City to cross, connect, and share the journey.
artist: Golden Gate Bridge Art Car  by Johnno Lazetich

name: The Intergalactic Transporter
description: Hop on the IGT for transportation to the next galaxy!
artist: The Intergalactic Transporter by Chico Urban Area

name: Baby Shark Fin
description: The shark ate too many metal cans and swims under the playa. Watch out and get a bigger boat!
artist: Baby Shark Fin by Neil J

name: Azeban - The Trash Panda
description: Azeban the Trash Panda is a raccoon art car, lighting up the night and seeking out the people, places and mischief which make Burning Man so unique.
artist: The Trash Panda by the Black Rock Bandits

name: Moby- The Rainbow Fish
description: A vibrant, LED-lit mutant vehicle shaped like a rainbow fish, with glowing scales and whimsical, flowing fins, creating a mesmerizing, colorful spectacle embodying the principles of generosity, connection, and celebration of uniqueness.
artist: Cassandra Caron, James Trebesch & the Ocean Crew

name: ShroomVroom
description:
The ShroomVroom is the motorized stump of a great tree adorned with a giant mushroom - on which a wise hookahsmoking
caterpillar has taken residence. Inspired by "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland" - the classic Lewis Carroll novel.
artist: Shroom Vroom by the Dust Circus Team

name: Hello Yellow Towing and Floating Crap Game
description: Work or fun, Hello Yellow's the one!

name: AntiDysentery
description: The AntiDysentery Conestoga wagon is capable of discharging flames at over 1.5 million BTU's.

name: Whipple 3
description: The Calico Dragon is one of the most approachable cars on playa.  With long couches lining both sides of the vehicle and a single step up to sit down makes this vehicle less intimidating for burners to hop on and enjoy the ride.

name: Kokomotive
description: KokoMotive is a  Steam Punk themed, Locomotive featuring Dance Platform and a flying saucer atop the cage on back of vehicle.
artist: KokoMotive by Hylbyly and KokoMotive crew

name: Ghost Slipper
description: This vehicle is shaped like an Alladins Slipper. It is usually wearing a blue dress, but can occasionally be out on the play on a silver one.  It is covered in over 1,000 individually addressable LED Lights and contains a very discrete 11 speaker Sound System.

name: Third Eye Scream
description: The iconic Third Eye Scream is play on the Illuminati, and a symbol of enlightenment.  You can find it parked somewhere gifting ice cream or floating on the horizon playing mystical tunes in Deep Playa at night.

name: Prodigal Swan
description: Prodigal Swan is an interactive art car designed to evoke wonder and connection. With illuminated wings and a dramatic flame effect, it offers a visually stunning experience. More than just a vehicle, it's a moving piece of art that invites engagement and fosters community.

name: Disco Hauler
description: The Disco Crew and its helpers will spread joy and cheer to the Burners and dancers around the playa and give thanks and appreciation to the best week of my life.

name: La Playa Familia
description: La Playa Familia is an art car inspired by the breathtaking beauty of La Sagrada Familia and the spirit of human connection. Just as the Playa brings together people from around the world to share, create, and connect, Familia offers a space where everyone feels welcome—a moving sanctuary of belonging, unity, and shared experience.

name: Hel's Diner
description: Hel's Diner is that Art Car with the two tall red towers that has food, a bar and music.

name: Tauntaun
description: A floating Tauntaun travels across the desert carrying a crusty burner.  Whom tamed whom?

name: Ready Go Train Tours
description:
Ready Go Black Rock City Train Tours!

Since 1907 we have been giving purely information tours around BRC and we are the only Tour LLC with licensing to legally operate according to the BMOrg Tour Inspection Committee.

Learn all about the history of Burning Man, from it's initial incarnation as Larry Harvey's eighth birthday party to the sprawling metropolis it is today!

Get to see art that regular BRC citizens haven't heard of, and even get a chance to ride the hidden subterranean tunnels that connect the 3 and 6 o'clock plaza, only on the Ready Go Black Rock City Train Tours!

name: Kodo: Mecha Shogun
description: Kodō – The Mecha Shogun leads an army of sound-synced warriors—on a mission to bring balance through sonics, and create harmonious cosmic rhythms.
artist: Kodō: Mecha Shogun by Darin Gardner

name: Clyde the Ghost
description: Clyde the ghost looks exactly like he came directly off the screen of PacMan the video game
artist: Clyde the Ghost by Ghost Frequencies

name: Castle Glowskull
description: A 14' tall glowing driving skull car
artist: Castle Glowskull and the Glowskull Asylum

name: Salt Cube
description: An interactive exploration of scale and logic, Salt Cube transforms classic toys into a large light installation on wheels. This bright yellow construction toy truck carries a 6-foot LED cube synced to a handheld tactile controller. As participants manipulate the puzzle cube in their hand, the larger-than-life LED cube on the truck responds in real-time, reflecting every twist and turn of the colors. It's a collective childhood memory, amplified for the open playa.

name: Apollonia
description: Apollonia is an EV Mutant Vehicle that is made of 61 LED rings and edge light dichroic acrylic. The tangent circles carapace reflects the light of the playa in beautiful colors during the day, and at night are a delight of LED's animations. Apollonia is pure geometry and color without a literal reference, triggering the imagination about its possible origins and inspiration.

name: Playa Predator
description:
A friendly little shark car with a voracious appetite for pleasing people. The flame system
provides a unique elevated flame pit that is a beacon at night.

name: SS Mezcal
description: SS Mezcal is a solar powered electric mutant vehicle styled as a fractured mezcal barrel from the future. The SS stands for spaceship, a tongue in cheek nod to a craft that cruises the dust instead of the space. Built as a moving gift rather than a private party, it rolls up to create quick moments with strangers: a toast, a short dance, a tiny ritual, or a good story. The crew actively hosts and keeps it welcoming. Spot us on playa, flag us down and jump aboard!
artist: SS Mezcal by Rubber Armstrong Crew

name: Red Rooster Ranch
description: A playful rendition of the notorious "pleasure palaces and cathouses" that were common in Nevada's gold & silver rush of the late1800's
artist: Red Rooster Ranch by Dale Weber and the RRR family

name: Blue Bull
description:
"Blue Bull" is a mutant vehicle inspired by Maria Prymachenko's 1947 artwork of the same name, transforming Ukrainian folk art into a bold, mobile presence on the playa.
Covered in plush, UV-reactive blue fur, this monumental creature glows at night and moves through Black Rock City with immersive sound and dynamic lighting. Sunset and select evening DJ sets activate it as a vibrant yet welcoming gathering space.
More than a sound vehicle, Blue Bull is a roaming cultural statement — a living interpretation of Ukrainian artistic heritage, reimagined as a surreal, participatory environment where people meet, dance, and share in a collective moment of creativity.

name: SABOKU
description: SABOKU is your friendly furry monster. Warm and bright. We promote slow cruising. No speeding!

name: Fluffy
description: Fluffy is a dual level fire breathing gargoyle, that is fully custom built mutant vehicle.

name: Fins of fortune
description:
Fins of Fortune is a koi-inspired art cart embodying the ancient legend of transformation through art, food, light, and performance. This steampunk-sculpted koi glows with animated LED scales that pulse in rhythm, telling the story of the fish who swam upstream, leapt the Dragon Gate, and became a dragon.

This is not a rideable vehicle, but a roaming immersive installation designed to spark joy and interaction. At its heart is a taiyaki station gifting koi-shaped treats and milk teas. Whimsical aviator fish-fin characters and interactive performers animate the space with playful movement and storytelling rooted in Asian symbolism.

name: The Monkey
description: The Monkey was created for cruises on the playa, easy accessibility for all burners to jump on and enjoy the art and beauty that Burning Man provides each year.

name: Earth and Sky
description:
The Earth and Sky is a fully transformed Mutant Vehicle that bears no resemblance to its base chassis. The vehicle presents as a 10-foot diameter extraterrestrial scout craft resting on armored tank treads. All automotive cues have been eliminated. No visible car body panels, headlights, bumpers, or stock framing remain.
The sculpted fiberglass hull, integrated lighting band, and open-air square cockpit establish a complete visual transformation consistent with Burning Man's Mutant Vehicle requirements. The craft reads clearly as an art object first and transportation second.

name: The Nudibranch
description: The Nudibranch  is a 25-foot bus converted to a large nudibranch (underwater sea slug) that serves as a mobile event space, sound stage, dance platform on top of the bus, and an aquarium themed lounge area inside the bus, all inspired by the beauty and uniqueness of the Nudibranch – hypnotically beautiful underwater sea slugs found across the world.
artist: Nudibranch Art Car by Nudibranch Art Collective

name: HunDroid
description: Hungarian assisted self driving Mooncar
artist: HunDroid Art Car by the Palinka Lounge Crew

name: Glorb the beignet max pro 2 too
description: Glorb is a fully electric remote controlled art car designed to showcase the transition to an all electric sustainable future.  Don't try to listen or smell for Glorb's approach, because Glorb is silent with a delightful lack of gasoline fumes that are common on so many art cars.  Your ears and nose are no good here.  To find Glorb, you must use your eyes or your heart.  Look for a bright glowing cube at night, a holographic rainbow cube during the day, and follow the feeling of the vibes of love and friendship in your heart.
artist: Glorb The Beignet Max Pro 2 too by The Glorb Crew

name: Fishtank
description: The Fishtank..the lovable beast from the deep wellcomes all to come ride/chill or dance

name: Playa Del Soul
description: Playa Del Soul is an Oasis on the playa. A giant Beach Lounge Chair for the masses. Hop on up and get a ride or just enjoy the padded daytime shade or vibrant night time light show.
artist: PLAYA DEL SOUL BY MR. PICKLES

name: SM Cascabel
description: Cascabel is a trajinera - the iconic flower-covered gondolas of Xochimilco, Mexico City - reimagined as an electric art car. Built by LaCalaca Village, a camp with over a decade on playa and creators of the Axolotl art car, Cascabel carries the living cultural tradition of Mexico's ancient waterways to the desert. Thirteen feet of hand-painted baroque arch, cushioned lounge seating, and a sound system pointed inward for intimate cruising. Different nights, different names scrawled in chalk on the arch — each voyage a small floating world. Come find us. Hop on. No invitation needed.

name: Lil' Playa Plane
description:
The Lil' Playa Plane was created to bring out the Lil' People in all of us. It is designed to bring back the memories of childhood,
when we were all fascinated with the simplest of interactions. Sounds, Lights, and Fun Simple Songs. Whether watching it drive by or jumping aboard the Lil' Playa Plane brings smiles and nostalgia from everyone who comes in contact with it. The Lil' Playa Plane is loved by everyone and still has the unofficial title as the "cutest"
art car on the playa.
artist: Lil' Playa Plane and Playa Plane Ground Crew

name: The Great Sammich Ride
description:
Are you hungry? I'm your hot cinnamon-butter joy injection.
Actually, I'm a giant, squishy peanut butter and jelly Sammich with wings. You can eat me! You can dance with me! You can hitch a ride on my cushy peanut-butter wings!
I'm here to deliver joy on the playa by serving hot 'n toasty cinnamon-butter grilled, gluten-free gourmet PB&J's.
Look for my rotating "Sammiches" marquee sign and hop on board for a loungy ride around the ol' dust bowl at exactly Whenever O'clock.  And if you really want fun, join my Sammich crew in serving up hot toasty delights to other hungry burners today.
Because as my Grandma Sammich once told me:
"There's no holier act than helping others get the goody out of life."
Come play!
- The Great Sammich Ride

name: Dandy
description: Come take a magical ride on a floating bed of dandelions.

name: The Dancing Peacock
description: The Dancing Peacock spreading love, and offering rides to all on the playa.
artist: The Dancing Peacock by Roger Stinson

name: Sebastian
description: Sebastian is a lovable, vibrantly colorful little fish art car that loves company!
artist: Sebastian by Jason Tang & Las Vegas Burners

name: Red Hot Beverly -- The Fire "Extinguisher"
description: Red Hot Beverly -- The Fire "Extinguisher" welcomes everyone with dirty beats and giant fire to keep you toasty on chilly nights. Come dance with us or jump on board to roam the playa and see all the amazing art. Eventually, we'll see you at the trash fence!
artist: Red Hot Beverly by Crisis Labs

name: DragonRider
description:
DragonRider is a delightful recreation of a 20 foot captured green Sea Dragon restrained on top of a small Viking Longboat. 
Watch in fascination as he shakes her head snaps her jaws flaps her fins, shakes her tail and bellows in complaint at her capture. Watch out she may spray you with a mist of seawater if you get too close!

name: Rocket 'n Roll
description: The Rocket n Roll mutant vehicle is a rocket powered, old time Juke Box designed to bring joy, light and fantastic music to Black Rock City. Catch a ride with us as we explore the deep Playa, dance to the eclectic, surprising music playing on the huge Juke box, bath in the glow of our mirror balls and experience the juicy red lips and tongue that lead the Rocket 'n Roll through dusty adventures every night!
artist: Rocket 'n Roll by The Lotus Art Car Team

name: Wanda
description: Known as Wanda, this mutant vehicle wonderful highly articulated creation of the rarely seen deep sea creature known as Angler Fish. Day or night, the vehicle is highly visible and easily recognizable as same to those who have seen pictures of this illusive creature.

name: Ha-Ha-Ha Harvey
description:
Reclaimed 1970 Glastron Speedboat hull mounted on a reclaimed 1994 G5 Yamaha Golf Cart Chassis. Painted ocean
wave skirts, seating for 12 people, bike racks, LED light strings throughout including up the mast with white strobes on
top, groovy sound system, shade Bimini Top, sounding bell, plus a buckled reclaimed kayak that appears smashed on
the bow. Hop aboard, matey!

name: Helga
description: Helga the Viking Ship

name: Suck
description: Suck the vacuum cleaner

name: Kevin
description: 'Kevin' One Of The Most Beloved Small Art Cars On The Playa.
artist: MV Kevin brought to you by The Tequila Bees

name: The Frog Prince
description: The Frog Prince is a giant frog with a golden crown and kissable purple lips. Rock out with your friends on 2 decks. Leave only frog prints behind.

name: Forest House
description: The Forest House Art Car is a two-story mobile art piece featuring 30,000 LEDs and a Void Acoustics sound system. It offers an immersive experience with vibrant lighting and powerful audio, creating a dynamic space for exploration, music, and creative expression.
artist: Forest House by the Forest House Art Crew

name: Burning Man Bunny Car
description:
Take a break from the everyday and hop into the pink fur-lined world of The Bunny Car—Burning Man's heartwarming mutant vehicle.
More than just a vehicle, The Bunny Car lifts spirits, sparks laughter, and leaves a dusty trail of memories and wonder.

Get in. Hold on. And let The Bunny Car take you there.

name: TOWER69
description: TOWER69 is a mobile lifeguard tower transformed into an interactive art vehicle. Inspired by the iconic lifeguard towers of the California coast. The structure becomes a playful lookout, gathering point, and moving stage  across the desert. By day it offers shade and views, and by night it glows with lighting and music, creating a welcoming space for connection, exploration, and spontaneous moments on the playa.

name: La Rana Hypnótica
description: A hypnotic and colorful frog who glides around the Playa offering rides to dusty burners. You'll be mesmerized by his changing colors and dapper appearance.

name: Scrampi
description:
Scrampi, our Mutant Vehicle for Burning Man, promotes creativity, community, and playfulness, fostering joy and connection among attendees. With its vibrant colors and whimsical nautical decor, it aims to spark conversation and wonder. 

In addition to providing rides, Scrampi will offer refreshing nautical beverages to keep participants hydrated and will play fun nautical-themed music to enhance the experience. 

Aligned with the theme "Axis Mundi," Scrampi encourages attendees to embrace their playful sides and discover the unexpected. More than just transportation, it provides an immersive experience that celebrates art, community, and connection at Burning Man. We look forward to welcoming everyone aboard for a memorable journey!

name: Ziggy Star Duster
description: Ziggy Starduster is a retro desert speeder inspired by the classic sci fi vehicles many of us remember from childhood. It started life as a small convertible and was rebuilt with a custom welded frame and aluminum body panels to create a low floating landspeeder style vehicle. The glowing rear engines and ground lighting give it the feeling that it is hovering just above the playa at night. During the day it rolls across the dust like something from another world. Our goal is simple, bring a little desert sci fi imagination to Black Rock City and share rides and good vibes with fellow burners along the way.
artist: Marc Abouaf & Vernon Rich (Ziggy Star Duster)

name: Chelonix Art Car
description: Chelonix is a giant glowing space turtle roaming the playa. Built on a box truck platform, the vehicle features a wooden turtle shell structure, an animatronic head, inflatable flippers, and a central dance floor where participants can gather, climb, and explore. Flowing fabrics conceal the truck beneath and evoke an underwater kelp forest moving through the desert wind. By day, Chelonix appears as a playful ocean creature crossing the dust. By night, thousands of LEDs transform it into a luminous cosmic turtle swimming through Black Rock City.
artist: Chelonix Art Car by the fireborntools crew

name: Magnolia Thunderpussy
description: Magnolia Thunderpussy, the mutant vehicle is a copper colored 21 foot Pangolin, based on an endangered species from Africa and China. She is made from over 800 hand cut steel scales.
artist: Magnolia Thunderpussy by Jennifer Cull Artist

name: BLACK ROCK CIRCUS WAGON
description: The Black Rock Circus Wagon with the Trained gorilla on a unicycle pulling the wagon !

name: Disco Roboto Iron GIant
description: Disco Roboto Iron Giant is a playa people mover, inspiring dance, laughter, lights, flames, and community.
artist: Iron Giant by Lewbel and Disco Roboto Crew

name: Sparky the Star Trek Shuttlecraft
description: its a ford aerostar van taken down to its floorboards and rebuilt as a shuttlecraft from startek

name: Cow
description: Ride-able cow

name: A Streetcar Named DESIRE
description:
A Streetcar Named Desire. Transport vehicle with authentic Streetcar roof system. Design includes handicap access
and wheelchair access (2). Can accommodate 16(+)(-) comfortably.
artist: A Streetcar named DESIRE, multiple contributors

name: Whiskers
description: A purrfectly playful rideable cat!

name: XUZA
description:
Step into the surreal world of XUZA, a fully mutated two-level art car that has been prowling Black Rock City since 2014. Forged in Las Vegas, NV, XUZA is a spectacle of light, sound, and fire, blending futuristic technology with radical creativity.

With hypnotic CGI-driven eyes, pulsating LED tentacles, a pixel-mapped LED ceiling, and dynamic fire effects, XUZA is more than a vehicle—it's an immersive journey into the unknown. Flames erupt in sync with the music as XUZA prowls through the dust or ignites the night at art burns and The Man.

Whether cruising or stationed at an event, XUZA invites all to step aboard, connect, and experience a world where sound, fire, and motion merge into a shared adventure.

name: Helios
description: Helios serves as a reminder of what it means to be human. In this age of technology, we need to keep our connection with nature. Life is beautiful.

name: Ohmu of the Valley of the WInd
description: Ohmu is a sentient pillbug-like creature that's very strong yet sensitive. They have green shells and 14 eyes that are usually blue but can turn red when they've been angered. Ohmu were a race of large terrestrial arthropods that formed on Earth following the Seven Days of Fire that engulfed the planet which transformed much of the surface into the hostile Cursed Earth. The Ohmu were one of many creatures that the previous humans had created in order to purify their polluted world. As Ohmu traverses the Playa, it cleans up any MOOP, embodying the leave no trace principle and to help purify the playa.

name: Mudpuppy
description: A pixelated Proteidae emerges from the block biome to hypnotize humanity with a bio-luminescent display of diodes

name: Dream Drifter
description: Dream Drifter is a solar-powered canopy-bed that moves you seamlessly between dreams and the magic of the desert.

name: Dream Genie
description: A magical traveling genie bottle

name: Sweet Car Bed
description: Sweet Car Bed, by Andy Henry.
artist: Sweet Car Bed by Andy Henry

name: Dust-e
description: After WALL-E cleaned up all the MOOP on Earth for humanity, he decided to head to Burning Man with his Playa name "DUST-E". His new directive will be clearing MOOP in the  Black Rock City with his cute appearance and innocent demeanor. He's looking forward to interfacing and shaking his can at Robot Heart.
artist: Dust-e with his BNL crew, Spanky and Jewalia.

name: Vroom Vroom
description: Vroom Vroom is a giant Roller Skate that's a tribute and homage to roller skaters around the world. I've been skating for 14 years and love the community of skaters I've met.
artist: Ivizia Dakini, Adam Goldthwaite, Blake Hicks

name: Clown Car
description: Clown Car is a small cart size vehicle with a giant yellow happy face in front and a giant red clown bowler on top.  The custom widened, low profile looking  metal body has a fire truck feel.  The custom upholstery adds a lot of great colors to the R G B L LED lighting system,

name: Mush: The Magic Myco Mobile
description: This magical field of mushrooms lofts above its turtle's back waiting to shade you and take you on a trip to see the wonders the burn has to offer.
artist: Mush: The Magic Myco Mobile's Art Car Crew

name: Dust Slug
description: Dust Slug is a prehistoric beast reincarnated from the dust of the dry Lahontan lakebed that is now called Black Rock Desert. With dazzling nighttime color displays and tentacles blowing in the wind it entrances BRC citizens to join it in its endless wandering.
artist: Dust Slug by the Dust Slug Den

name: Grand Lind Voyager
description: Grand Lind Voyager (In Estonian "lind" meaning "bird") is a mutant vehicle built by Estonian Burners. Like migrating birds, Estonians fly over the clouds to the Black Rock Desert. Almost every year, some since 2008.

name: Playa Pizza Portage
description: The Playa Pizza Portage is a happy and bright little slice, traveling the Playa, to bring joy and sustenance to adventurers anywhere they find us.
artist: Playa Pizza Portage by Rusty & Kinky Pizza

name: SirKiss
description: The SirKiss art car is a double decker circus themed art car where everyone is allowed to join for a ride or a dance party.

name: CHEESUS SAVES (formerly blue cheese)
description: We are a magical block of cheese bringing outstanding grilled cheese, music and mediocre conversion to the furthest corners of the playa. Find us deep playa or at a dance party serving up our delicious body of crust (grilled cheese squares cooked to perfection) or an ice cold beverage from our cooler. When you see the cheese glowing in the distance stop by and see if we are serving...

name: The Lightbringer
artist: Adam Phelps and the Lightbringer Crew

name: Vessel of Love
description:
The Vessel of Love is a glowing mobile lounge designed to spread connection and joy across the playa. 
Built from a mutated electric golf buggy, it features a cozy cuddle puddle for passengers to relax together and a small viewing deck above for taking in the magic of Black Rock City. 
Inspired by our Vessels of Love art installation and its infinity heart theme, the vehicle travels the playa sharing warmth, music, and spontaneous moments of togetherness. With vibrant LED lighting and a welcoming atmosphere, the Vessel of Love invites burners to pause, connect, and experience a little more love on the journey.

name: RocketCar
description: The Rocket Car is a handmade desert rocket built from salvaged machines and aircraft parts. Its body began as a surplus aircraft drop tank that was reshaped into a narrow aluminum fuselage. Powered by a Honda CX500 motorcycle engine and rolling on rescued MG axles, it looks like a strange experimental rocket cruising the playa. The Rocket Car roams Black Rock City and deep playa offering spontaneous rides and photo moments to curious travelers. By day it looks like a scrap built test vehicle from another era, and by night its glowing lights make it appear like a small wandering rocket exploring the desert.

name: Souper Lounge
description: Welcome to the Souper Lounge—your floating, funky soup bowl on wheels! This art car is a neon-lit, noodle-pillow paradise, complete with veggie plushies, fuzzy carpets, and a whole lotta cozy vibes. We're serving up hot broths and soups straight from the back to keep you warm or cool (depending on how much fun you're having). Hop in, chill out, and let's get saucy! The Souper Lounge is your new favorite hangout, where soup, silliness, and community come together in the most deliciously ridiculous way. We will have intimate DJ sets, open mic nights, sound healings and more as we cruise around the playa! Come for the broth, stay for the friends—and maybe a veggie plushie or two!

name: Proto
description: Proto is a steam punk inspired, fire breathing dragonfly time machine that is named after the extinct order of gigantic dragonfly's known as Protodonata. We offer rides to everyone-please ask when you see us!
artist: Dragonfly Swarm by Chris Merrick and Camp Fly

name: The PUGG
description: The PUGG...much more than just a practical uplifting galactic gadget.
artist: The PUGG by Kobra, JMFC, and the Hobby Garage Crew

name: Giving Tree
description: The Giving Tree art car brings a unique one of a kind immersive experience to the imagination of creation. She's a willow tree that stands 25 feet tall, 28 feet long, 24 feet wide. Her trunks base is 21 feet long, 8 feet wide. It's a unmutilated 1989 Blue Bird short bus tiny home that hides inside her trunk which makes for a very grounded mobile or stationary tree house on wheels. You can ascend up a 6 foot tree ladder through a hatch door that lets you access the upper rooftop party deck. In the center of the rooftop the trunk continues up with a 5 foot tree ladder to a crows nest also with safety railings. From the crows nest just under the top canopy of willow branches the views of any event are spectacular.
artist: Giving Tree art car by Adam DeDecker

name: The Lookout
description:
The Chakora bird sits every night gazing at the indifference of the moon. He is in deep, enduring love with her, and has dedicated his life to her beauty. He bathes in her moon light, sits patiently without regret, and captures her moonbeams in his feathers. After a long night, he goes home to his small laboratory, The Lookout, and gently sifts through all the moonbeams. He puts them in bottles and sends them out into the world.

A tiny wooden house, with stained glass windows and hidden secret messages will be pushed around by mosaic clouds and a mosaic moon. This is the laboratory of the Charkora, and is meant for people to sit with the moon beams and feel the universal language of complete love.

name: Pyramix
description: 30 ft wide , 30 ft tall, three level, three-sided Pyramid car
artist: Pyramix  designed and built by Douglas Bosworth

name: Human Heart
description: Human Heart is a visual pun on Robot Heart that plays primarily acoustic music
artist: Human Heart by Jerry Snyder + Midnight Museum Team

name: GoCaBo
description: A land lubbin' Playa Boat

name: Earth Exploration Vehicle 101
description: A small manned exploration rover, built to observe the creatures of Earth among their routine day to day lives.

name: HAL: Lunar Rover-Redux
description:
HAL 2.0: Lunar Rover is a 70's Retro concept inspired by Stanley Kubrick's 2001 A Space Odyssey and Irwin Allen's
Lost in Space.
artist: HAL 2.0: Lunar Rover created by Darin Gardner

name: The Surly Bird
description:
The Surly Bird is the double decker art car of Surly Camp. She first debuted on the playa in 2003 and has undergone some amazing and imaginative transformations since then. As the DMV and Burning Man community are demanding higher quality art and ingenuity, the crew of Surly Camp rises to the occasion, offering the eyes new and inspiring imagery. 2012 brought forth the Surly Phoenix, with laser eyes and feathers galore. Lots of hard work went into this baby, and the DMV seemed happy enough... 

The crew of Surly Camp steps up each year in a big way to give the old girl a fresh coat of love. They drive and fly in from all over the states to help out in the months before Burning Man. They do it out of love. They do it for you.
artist: The Surly Bird and Surly Camp

name: Serenity
description: Serenity started out in the back yard of an antique store. She was a WW2 drop tank that was attached to military planes. She was used to drop flares, paper leaflets with warnings and supplies from her belly. When I found her she was filled with leaves from a few decades ago. I had to have her, I had to give her a new life of gifting to others. She can now give a ride to those in need or a drink to those who are thirsty or she can simply be seen in her beauty as burners stand back and admire her mutated sprit, sole, and transformation. Everything about her had a different life. She is made from salvaged recycled parts, from school chairs to a bone yard of crashed, given up ATV's and speakers covered in dust in a corner of a pawn shop.

name: Horse
description: Horse was adopted from the BLM pens in Spanish Springs, Nevada.  She has returned to her homeland range in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. A gentle soul she is, but she can also buck the most robust of cowboys.  Horse is typically happy to help weary travelers to their destination. She can often be found checking the fencelines at BRC, and is always looking for fellow horses to gallop across the range with.

name: Steampunk Weighted Companion Cube
description:
The Aperture Science Enrichment Center reminds you that the Weighted Companion Cube will never threaten to stab you and, in fact, cannot speak. However, any advice it does give you should be radically included.

The Weighted Companion Cubes are from the computer game "Portal"; this year there will be two, one companion cube and one steampunk cube. They are single rider, mobile art pieces, a 3 foot square cube, with sound and lights.

Remember, the cake is a lie!

name: Giraffic Jam
description: This Giraffe is not messing around. He learned that people think he is cute and cuddly and he has decided to change his image with fire!

name: The Whomp Wagon
description: The Whomp Wagon was created as a platform where musicians of all genres can perform and share their gift for everyone. Burning Man changed our lives for the better and forever! The Whomp Wagon is our way of giving back to the BURNING MAN community!
artist: Whomp Wagon Creator Patrick Conners & Whomp Crew

name: REDEMPTION
description:
We started out with a zero turn Kubota lawnmower and eliminated everything but the drivetrain and motor. 

We named her Redemption because she started out as a lawnmower 20 years ago, slaving away and working hard. She is redeeming herself in a way to be shared amongst all Burners; for those that want to climb in for a picture, simply want to enjoy the ride, or to assist them in getting from one place to another. Redemption will provide a unique experience that our camp and others can enjoy.

name: Monstrosity
description: Monstrosity is a steampunk-era peace keeping vehicle used to transport passengers into new time dimensions. Its artistic design, details, and lighting will astound and inspire

name: I Think I Can
description: I Think I Can - tugboat—a whimsical vessel cruising the playa, complete with nautical details and fun crew onboard!
artist: I Think I Can by Marko K.

name: Pyrobar
description: The Pyrobar is a classically-styled Bohemian Gem bringing it's unique experience to the Playa since 2004 and whether it's a warm greeting or sassy party, this fiery relic heats up the soul before dousing it with a healthy dose of firewater.

name: Chatterbox
description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant cacophony of creativity with the Chatterbox Art Car. This rolling masterpiece serves as a mobile platform for spontaneous conversations, fueled by the energy of the playa. Adorned with mesmerizing humans and pulsating with music, the Chatterbox invites participants to engage in dynamic dialogues, forging connections that transcend boundaries. Join the journey aboard this mobile marvel and experience the magic of community, expression, laughter and exploration!
artist: Chatterbox Art Car by Cassie Plant and Crew

name: Flux Capacitor
description: Only stupid people would attempt to build a car like this. Or really dumb people. One of the two.

name: BrainCar
description: Is it a cloud... or a brain? Perhaps a rabbit with its ears up? You decide! Spot the curious little internal organ trundling through the dust or lighting up the night.

name: Petabyte
description: Consisting of over a million fiber optics and contributions from many of our brilliantly talented friends, Petabyte is BYTE's most collaborative and extraordinary expression of light, sound and tactility yet!

name: Thong patrol
description:
The thong patrol!
A multi-purpose art car designed to look like a flip flop and feel like your at the beach. A 100% electric art car designed to make a small footprint on a big beach. A functional art car/service vehicle loaded with tools to fix anything anywhere!

name: Hsssisss - the Baby Sea Dragon
description: Hssiss - the Baby Sea serpent Dragon is the love child of Abraxas the golden dragon that has been roaming the playa since 2006. She is a zippy little dragon that loves to roam the outer playa finding play mates to pick up and go on adventures with. She loves good music and sunrises and long drives on the playa. she is a shinny beautiful creature that comes when called and  will do tricks for love. She tends to stick close to her mum (when her mum is in fine form) and likes to cast shade and bring beverages and snacks to the wandering folk of black rock city.

name: The Underneath
description: The Underneath is a glowing decomposer-on-wheels, where personal and planetary composting become one regenerative act.
artist: Rachel Zucker and Shlomo Zippel and Sean Stillwell

name: Electric Candy Car
description:
Electric Candy Car, the colorful bursting bag of candies which invites you to hop on for a
sweet, joyful journey.
artist: Electric Candy Car by Neal Milch

name: Heavy Meta
description: Heavy Meta is a terrifying, hand-cut sheet metal-clad fire-breathing dragon. Featuring interactive flame, sound and light effects, Heavy Meta can accommodate up to 30 people, and will be traversing the open playa day and night.

name: Iron Butterfly
description: A giant butterfly of bright fabric and aluminum. During the day, an oasis with lots of shade and cold beverages. At night, chill and dreamy rides.
artist: Iron Butterfly by Bobby Stimmler Johnson

name: Cleo
description: Cerberus, the three headed dog
artist: Cleo by Cleo Art Car Team

name: The Dirty Sardine
description: The Dirty Sardine is a mutant vehicle designed to look like an open sardine can with a purpose to pack in and meet fellow burners on the playa.
artist: The Dirty Sardine by Ken Zimmerman

name: Fjörgyn
description: The Fjorgyn is a 42 foot  Viking longboat with a crows nest and billowing multicolored sail. To look upon it will bring you back to the days of the original pirates of Nordic times.
artist: Fjörgyn by Troy/Jeannie Morgan & Dennis Alumbaugh

name: BURNSTREAM POINT LIGHTHOUSE
description: Burnstream Point Lighthouse is a nomadic lighthouse, roaming the playa and welcoming travelers home! When you see the sweeping beam of the vintage rotating DCB-36 beacon you will know you have found your way to the exact place you should be. Standing over thirty feet tall and fully mobile, the lighthouse is one-of-a-kind! Come join us for a ride. We are looking forward to meeting you!
artist: Burnstream Lighthouse by Red Level Lighthouse LLC

name: Playatech Flaming Castle
description: The Playatech Flaming Castle presents as smoldering 20'x12'x12' castle, made of Playatech slotted plywood parts with plush royal red décor and flame-like lighting, over a bronze-colored steel framework and armature, which are welded over a chopped '91 Volvo 240 sedan that is completely hidden except windshield and front side windows. By night, The Castle's bright red tower can be seen across the playa, while closer in it offers a subtle welcoming fire-like lighting experience.

name: Sky Ting
description: SkyTing is crewed by a group of humans from 1000 years in the future who bring advanced understanding of frequency, community, and the possibility of thriving queer community in the face of ecological collapse. Our rituals bring us face to face with our human need to grieve and celebrate with each other and the earth.

name: Dakini Hathini
description: A neon-pink fuzzy elephant glowing like cotton candy under the Black Rock sky. LED eyes twinkling, trunk swaying to the beat—pure playa magic on four fuzzy legs. Hop on and ride the chaos!
artist: Happy Hanuman ; Happy Hanuman MV Crew

name: Zeong
description: "Witness the awe-inspiring Pui, evolved from a loyal sidekick into a colossal Gundam mech, dominating the Playa with style! Clad in shimmering armor, its thrusters roar like a desert storm, leaving trails of stardust in its wake. Armed with laser precision and an adorable battle stance, this mech-master patrols the wild sands, a perfect blend of cuddly charm and unstoppable might—ready to protect the Playa from any intergalactic mischief!"
artist: Happy Hanuman ; Happy Hanuman MV Crew

name: Mix Tape (aka White Lightening)
description:
Mix Tape is a drivable to scale classic cassette.  We encourage interaction through our selection of "choose your own tape" by allowing our audience to choose a custom playlist via cassette.  Pick and play.  
Stand with our DJ's, enjoy snacks and drinks on the playa as you bathe in dance music. Get a memory photo record.
artist: White Lightening by the Mix Tape Art Car Crew

name: Soulshakers Photo Serpent
description: Capture the moment on the Playa in our Interactive Photo Bus Serpent Hop in, strike a pose, and let the Soulshakers Photo Serpent  give you a memory to cherish long after you leave the Black Rock City.
artist: Photo Serpent By: Camp Soulshakers Art Team

name: Der Stier
description: Des Stier is a small mutant vehicle based on the game MineCraft.  German for 'The Bull', it is a longhorn steer/bull built around a pedal assist electric bike surrey.

name: Garden of Dreamin'
description: The Garden of Dreamin' is a lush, otherworldly escape where reality bends and imagination blooms. Winding paths lead through surreal landscapes of lava flows, whispering fungi, and glowing plants that sway with the breeze. It's a sanctuary for wanderers, lovers, and late-night thinkers.  Hop on and find yourself in a place where time slows, stars feel closer, and dreams drift freely among the alien trees.

name: Cubeish
description: A cube(ish) that lets you touch and hear and feel the music.

name: Russell The Love Muscle
description: Russell the Love Muscle is a whole lot of love! Taking your turn on this oversized phallic fella will definitely bring a smile to your face and  put a stir in your loins! He lives out front at Slutt Putt, but you never know where he might pop up on Playa if he needs to scratch an itch!

name: Mad Hatter
artist: Mad Hatter by the Dome Crew

name: The Scarab Art Car
description: Scarab is a fusion of metal, speakers, engine, and fabric, designed to create unforgettable moments of connection and energy.

name: The Cloud
description: The Cloud is a group project by a bunch of crazy tree people who like bright music and loud lights :)-

name: Golden Mean
description:
Golden Mean
The visually stunning vehicle takes its name from the golden ratio, a mathematical proportion that's said to produce aesthetically pleasing art and architecture. Other inspirations for the project include the Giant Pink Sea Snail from Doctor Doolittle, giant mechanical elephant puppets by Royal de Luxe and Jules Verne's imaginative creations.
artist: Kyrsten Mate and Jon Sarriugarte and EOD

name: Sound Garden
description: Sound Garden is a whimsical and vibrant, lighted grass hill, blooming with flowers, cruising through the day and night, enveloping riders and onlookers in soundscapes and chill beats as they relax in comfort on the fluffy grass.
artist: Sound Garden Art Car by the Soundgarden Crew

name: Melton John
description: Melton is a double decker mobile piano lounge featuring live music.
artist: Melton John, By Black Rock Piano Lounge

name: Dreamtime MV
description: Dreamtime encourages and inspires us to unwind, unlock, and let our minds run free with imagination and curiosity. An island of calm in deep playa and beyond, find us and dream together.

name: Cash Only
description: A life size version of an operational closed circuit camera from the 1980s era capturing all the dusty Roving Voyeurism of BRC brought to you by BRCCTV. Only to be broadcast on the sides of the vehicle with an dLED matrix
artist: Cash Only, James Trebesch, Moon Landing

name: PV Monaco Inc
description: A square rigged 1/2 scale replica ship

name: Electric Toadstool
description: This scratch-built electric vehicle is remotely controlled, carries up to 8 people, and features over 3,000 LEDs plus a misting system to keep riders cool.

name: Bobbie the Polar Bear
description: We built Bobby the Polar Bear to share our art with the community and bring something new and fun to Black Rock City. Bobby is the ultimate party animal who would love to contribute to all the parties that exist on the Playa. He also loves to give people polar bear rides on his back.

name: AquaZone Mobile Hydration Station
description: a beacon of hydration... A blue wave rising high in the midst of one of the driest places on earth, promising to slake your thirst and provide respite... a true oasis on wheels.
artist: AquaZone Mobile Hydration Station by Team BoyScout

name: Playa Trolly / Fun House
description: Experience the Playa Trolley / Fun House, a mobile party with a stunning display of lights and music that will immerse you in the heart of Burning Man. Whether inside or outside, this rolling work of art will keep you entertained as the Playa comes alive around you.

name: TransMission
description: Metal Mimi Camp's mutant vehicle, which is lovingly named TransMission, carries history and a long legacy forward. TransMission was created in memory of the beloved Tom Kennedy. His enduring impact is brought forward here. Many decades ago, Tom was one of Burning Man's original mutant vehicle artists. TransMission has been resurrected and recreated by San Francisco's metal artists Haideen Andersen, Dana Albany and Flash.
artist: TransMission by Dana Albany, Haideen, Lisa Lavish

name: Fox Art Car
description:
The Fox Art Car is a fully transformed electric vehicle reimagined as a glowing, geometric fox that roams the playa. Built from a welded steel frame and wrapped in repurposed sailcloth, it comes alive at night with color changing LEDs and deep green glowing eyes. Designed to be open and social, riders sit facing one another, creating space for connection, laughter, and shared experience. More than a vehicle, it is an interactive, moving sculpture that invites participation,
sparks curiosity, and brings playful, mischievous energy to the community.
artist: Fox Art Car by Carolyn Gardella and the Fox Pack

name: DogFish
description: DogFish is one of the few remaining bar cars gifting beverages and water to anyone who needs a drink. Riders can sit comfortably on the outside barstools and back bench, or inside on the two long couches. Our bartenders are sure to make you smile!

name: Tuatara
description: Tuatara are reptiles endemic to New Zealand. Although resembling most lizards, they are more dinosaur than lizard. Their name derives from the Māori language, and means "peaks on the back"
artist: Charlie Hand - Artist / Jason Baratta - Handler

name: Great Sax
description: Great Sax is an artist's representation (NOT an exact depiction) of a large scale mobile Saxophone from a concept by professional Saxman, Rick Metz (Navigator RICK). It's equipped with a small, high quality sound system for playing recorded and live music. It's radically illuminated so that it's highly visible at night. It made its debut at BM 2023.
artist: Great Sax by Navigator RICK built by Jeff Rocke
